newsitem.title: USA: Segue sees Q2 results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Segue sees Q2 results below expectations.

text.p: Segue Software Inc said Monday said it expects to report second quarter results below its expectations, with earnings per share of about $0.01 compared to nil for the same period a year ago.
The company said estimated revenues for the quarter will be about $5.4 million compared to revenues of $3.5 million for the second quarter of 1996, or an increase of about 52 percent.
The company estimates a net profit of about $50,000 compared to a loss of about $29,000.
The company said demand for its products is strong as it enters the third quarter.
